title: g0.1-events-read-kind-contract-align
summary: Align serde contract of EventsReadKind enum with JsonSchema snake_case: 2-line change in crates/chronos-services/src/output.rs:1587 — derive extended to `Serialize, Deserialize` + new `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]`. 9 contract tests in crates/chronos-services/tests/events_read_kind.rs (serialize snake_case, deserialize snake_case, roundtrip, unknown rejected, PascalCase rejected after contract change, JsonSchema publishes snake_case, as_str ↔ Serde agree). Wire smoke /tmp/g0.1-wire-smoke (282 lines, JSON-RPC manual) against real chronos-mcp binary confirms mode:"query"/"by_id" accepted and mode:"Query" rejected with canonical 'expected query or by_id' message.
note: SHAs verified via git cat-file -e. Tag v0.7.112 peel 0be2ec2d intact. Breaking change explicit and asserted (test pascal_case_is_rejected_after_contract_alignment). Pre-existing failure detected during verification: client sandbox reads events at root vs server publishes result.events (C5.2 migration gap) — documented as M1+ follow-up, addressed in G0.4 cycle.
